'''King Crush''' was the trained [[Kintan crusher]] of [[Thades Gorkultok]], a gladiator in the [[Arena Grand]] of [[Zakuul]]. In [[3630 BBY]] Thades was put up against a newcomer known as "[[Alliance Commander|the Mysterious Stranger]]" and was defeated in the sixth round of the Arena fights along with King Crush.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
King Crush appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' as part of the sixth boss fight of "Eternal Championship".<ref name="SWTOR" />
